title: Separation of powers: added detail and limits

boxes.title: Why and how India chose fusion
items: Parliamentary system chosen for: **familiarity** (**1919/1935** Acts), diversity, avoiding **American-style** executive-legislature conflict
Ministers **must be legislators**; Council stays only with **confidence of the Lok Sabha**
Checks in parliamentary form: **questions**, confidence / no-confidence votes

boxes.title: Cases: added holdings
head: Case
Further point
rows: ==Executive power extends to matters the legislature can legislate on==
Deciding an election dispute = **judicial function**; separation part of **basic structure**
Dissolve Lok Sabha: **Art. 85(2)**; State Assembly by Governor

boxes.title: Override routes: limits
head: Route
Limit
rows: ==Removes the **basis**; cannot declare a judgment void or decide the dispute==
Subject to **judicial review**; must be **laid before the House**

boxes.title: Debates today
items: One Nation One Election critics: fixed tenure weakens collective responsibility (Arts. **75, 164**)
Frequent **Art. 142** use and **ordinance** route said to erode separation; judicial **overreach vs activism**
